changes: Read both existing files and preserved their earlier incident-query fixes and tests.
Recognize explicit build/create/generate scene commands with optional descriptors, removing command and scene words from the place.
Return optional normalized sceneStyle for prefixed descriptions and dash-separated scene/camera suffixes; style-only requests use build_scene unless they explicitly ask for an incident search.
Keep bare places and incident checks on incident_search, preserve existing event-description scene behavior and all existing result fields.
Remove time windows before interpreting location connectors so a temporal in does not replace the true place.
Add regressions for requested examples, optional styles, dashed place names, time windows, preserved fields, and absence of fabricated coordinates.
limitations: Parsing remains deterministic English-language heuristics, not general natural-language understanding.
Prefixed style descriptors are limited to eight words; dash-separated styles require a recognized scene/camera noun.
No place validation, coordinates, geocoding, or provider requests were introduced.
Composer/server integration was intentionally not edited or tested; only the owned unit-test file was run.
